user.title: Inverter entities
user.description: Select the entities from your existing Axpert / Voltronic integration that the battery plan will read and control.

data_description.soc_entity: Battery state of charge in percent.
data_description.voltage_entity: Optional. Used to estimate SOC only while the SOC sensor is unavailable.
data_description.output_priority_entity: Select entity for the output source priority (SBU / SOL / USB / SUB).
data_description.charger_priority_entity: Select entity for the charger source priority (OSO / CSO / SNU / UTI).
data_description.charge_current_entity: Optional. Set to the configured grid charge current when grid charging starts.

modes.title: Mode mapping

data.output_discharge_option: Output priority when discharging (SBU or SOL)
data.output_hold_option: Output priority when holding / grid charging (USB or SUB)
data.charger_no_grid_option: Charger priority with grid charging blocked (OSO)
data.charger_grid_option: Charger priority when grid charging (SNU or UTI)

settings.title: Tuning and inverter protection
settings.description: These settings limit how often inverter settings are written, which protects the inverter's EEPROM.

data_description.deadband: SOC must rise this far above target before discharging resumes, or fall this far below target before grid charging restarts.
data_description.charge_hysteresis: Grid charging continues until SOC reaches target plus this amount (capped at 100%).
data_description.update_interval: How often the plan is evaluated.
data_description.min_dwell_time: Rate limit for mode changes. Stopping discharge at the target, slot changes and your own edits are never delayed.
data_description.max_writes_per_day: Hard cap on inverter setting writes per day. Once reached, commands stop until midnight.
data_description.grid_charge_current: 0 leaves the current unchanged. Only used when a charge current entity is selected.
data_description.voltage_empty: Only used when the SOC sensor is unavailable and a voltage sensor is selected.
data_description.voltage_full: Must be higher than the 0% voltage.

error.entity_not_found: Entity not found. Make sure your Axpert integration is loaded.
error.same_entity: Output and charger priority must be different entities.
error.invalid_option: This value is not one of the entity's options.
error.same_option: Both plan states would use the same option; choose a different one.
error.voltage_range: The 100% voltage must be higher than the 0% voltage.

abort.already_configured: A battery plan for this SOC sensor already exists.
